roadmap.title: Escape Vault 111 and meet the Minutemen
roadmap.description: Finish the prologue, reach Sanctuary with Preston's group, and start the early kill, lockpick, and crafting counters before leaving the north-west Commonwealth.

roadmap.title: Search for Shaun and open every faction
roadmap.description: Push the main quest to Diamond City and Fort Hagen while joining the Brotherhood of Steel and Railroad, starting Automatron, and mashing the collectible and kill counters.

roadmap.title: Vault 88 and the workshop add-ons
roadmap.description: Run the Vault 88 questline, build Vault-Tec and Contraptions objects, and finish the 50-mod and 100-craft counters alongside settlement building.

roadmap.title: Minutemen, companions, and long counters
roadmap.description: Retake the Castle, recruit and max a companion, and clear the 300-kill, 50-objective, and giant-creature counters while exploring.

roadmap.title: Automatron and the Institute trail
roadmap.description: Finish the Mechanist storyline, then follow the Courser signal through Greentech Genetics and build the Signal Interceptor.

roadmap.title: Institute branch
roadmap.description: From the save after The Molecular Level, enter the Institute and complete its questline through Nuclear Family for the Institute ending.

roadmap.title: Arena and Wasteland Workshop builds
roadmap.description: Build the arena and every cage type, then tame five creatures for the Wasteland Workshop achievements.

roadmap.title: Brotherhood of Steel branch
roadmap.description: Reload the pre-conflict save and run the Brotherhood questline through Blind Betrayal and Ad Victoriam.

roadmap.title: Railroad branch and shared ending
roadmap.description: Reload the Brotherhood save and complete the Railroad questline, then drive a non-Institute ending for The Nuclear Option.

roadmap.title: Nuka-World
roadmap.description: Start the DLC from its own save, clear all five parks, craft every Nuka-Mix flavor, and build the raider outposts in the Commonwealth.

roadmap.title: Far Harbor
roadmap.description: Sail to Far Harbor, run the main arc for both outcomes using a save before Best Left Forgotten, and mop up its collectibles and creature kills.

achievements.description: Escape Vault 111 and reach the surface of the Commonwealth.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Escape Vault 111 and reach the surface of the Commonwealth.

steps.text: Play through the opening of the game until you take the elevator out of @loc{Vault 111} and step onto the surface.

achievements.description: Complete the main quest When Freedom Calls.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest When Freedom Calls.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Concord} and help the Minutemen fight the Raiders besieging the @loc{Museum of Freedom}.
Fight up through the museum to reach @npc{Preston Garvey} and the other survivors.
Escort the group to @loc{Sanctuary} and speak with @npc{Preston Garvey} when they arrive.
Agree to assist the @loc{Tenpines Bluff} settlers to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Complete the main quest Unlikely Valentine.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest Unlikely Valentine.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Park Street Station} and enter @loc{Vault 114}.
Push through the tunnels, clearing @enemy{Triggermen}, until you reach the vault entrance, then link up with @npc{Nick Valentine} in the Overseer's office.
Escape @loc{Vault 114} and tell @npc{Nick Valentine} you will meet him at his office in @loc{Diamond City}.

achievements.description: Complete the main quest Reunion.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the main quest Reunion.

steps.text: After leaving @loc{Kellogg's House}, show @npc{Dogmeat} the @item{San Francisco Sunlight Cigars} so he leads you to @loc{Fort Hagen}.
Confront @npc{Kellogg} at @loc{Fort Hagen}.
Before you report to @npc{Danse}, go back to @loc{Diamond City} and tell @npc{Nick Valentine} what you found at Fort Hagen.

achievements.description: Finish the main quest Dangerous Minds.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the main quest Dangerous Minds.

steps.text: At @loc{The Memory Den} in @loc{Goodneighbor}, speak with @npc{Nick Valentine} and @npc{Doctor Amari} to enter Kellogg's old memories.
View all of the memory sequences.
Interact with the TV in Kellogg's home to leave the dream.
Speak with Doctor Amari to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Complete the Main Quest Hunter/Hunted.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Main Quest Hunter/Hunted.

steps.text: Head to the @loc{C.I.T. Ruins} and set your Pip-Boy Radio to receive the Courser Signal.
Follow the signal east to @loc{Greentech Genetics}.
Track down the Courser and kill it, then take the @item{Courser Chip}; acquiring the chip unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the Main Quest The Molecular Level.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Main Quest The Molecular Level.

guide.context: This quest sets your faction alignment and is the branching anchor for the rest of the story. Make a manual save after it completes and before committing to any conflict quest.

steps.text: Deliver the @item{Courser Chip} to the @npc{Railroad} for decoding, then carry the decoded data to @npc{Virgil} in the @loc{Glowing Sea} to get the Signal Interceptor schematics.
When asked for help building the Signal Interceptor, choose the @npc{Railroad} and ask no one else.
Place the @item{Stabilized Reflector Platform} in any settlement, then go back to @npc{Tinker Tom} at Railroad HQ for the materials list.
At that same settlement, build the Control Console, the Molecular Beam Emitter, and the Relay Dish; the full setup needs 28 Power.
Step onto the Stabilized Reflector Platform to continue, which starts the Railroad Quest Underground Undercover.

achievements.description: Complete the Main Quest The Nuclear Option.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 9; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Main Quest The Nuclear Option.

guide.context: The ending shared by the Minutemen, Railroad, and Brotherhood, and mutually exclusive with Nuclear Family. For the Minutemen path, finish Taking Independence and Old Guns first.

steps.text: Battle your way to the @loc{Institute Reactor} and plant the @item{Fusion Pulse Charge} inside.
Vacate the @loc{Institute}, decide what to do with the Synth replica of @npc{Shaun}, and teleport back to the wasteland.
Watch the explosion to complete the quest and unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the Institute Quest Institutionalized.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Institute Quest Institutionalized.

guide.context: This starts the Institute line, which is mutually exclusive with the Brotherhood and Railroad lines and ends with Nuclear Family. When you first meet @npc{Father}, accept his offer; attacking him ends the Institute line and its achievements.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Institute} and load the @item{Network Scanner Holotape} from @npc{Desdemona} into the Computer Terminal in the next room.
Select copy encrypted message to initiate contact with @npc{Patriot}.
Leave the room and head to the nearby elevator, where @npc{Father} contacts you and offers the quest; accept his invitation to join the Institute and do not attack him.
Speak with each of the Institute's division leaders to unlock Fast Travel to the Institute and complete the quest.

achievements.description: Complete the Institute Quest Mankind-Redefined.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Institute Quest Mankind-Redefined.

guide.context: Part of the Institute line, which ends with Nuclear Family. The Institute, Brotherhood, and Railroad endings are mutually exclusive, so reload an earlier save to play the others.

steps.text: Once The Battle of Bunker Hill is over, meet @npc{Father} on the rooftop at the @loc{C.I.T. Ruins}.
Tell @npc{Shaun} that you were ambushed and the @npc{Railroad} was already waiting.
When Shaun returns to the @loc{Institute} by teleport, go with him and sit in on the directors board meeting.
Finish the meeting, then speak to @npc{Father} once more to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Complete the Institute Quest Powering Up.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Institute Quest Powering Up.

guide.context: Part of the Institute line. Make a Quick Save before delivering Father's speech, since how you deliver it is up to you.

steps.text: Once @loc{Mass Fusion} and Pinned are done, go back to the @loc{Institute} and talk to @npc{Father}.
Take the recorded speech to @loc{Diamond City Radio} and install the three @item{Radio Parts} to boost the signal.
Report back to @npc{Shaun}, bring the nuclear reactor online, and launch the Institute's broadcast.

Sit through the Institute Directors meeting and answer the council's questions, including whether to destroy the Brotherhood of Steel; the quest completes and the achievement unlocks when the meeting ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Main Quest Nuclear Family by siding with the Institute.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Main Quest Nuclear Family by siding with the Institute.

guide.context: The Institute ending, mutually exclusive with The Nuclear Option. Reload a save made before Mass Fusion to play the Brotherhood or Railroad endings. Completing it also unlocks Prepared for the Future.

steps.text: From the save made before @loc{Mass Fusion}, complete @loc{Mass Fusion} and the remaining Institute quests through @loc{Powering Up}.
Complete the Main Quest @loc{Nuclear Family} to become the new Director of the Institute and finish the main questline.

achievements.description: Complete the Minutemen quest The First Step.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Minutemen quest The First Step.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Preston Garvey}'s request to aid the @loc{Tenpines Bluff} settlers.
Travel to @loc{Tenpines Bluff} and speak with the settler.
Eliminate the Raiders occupying @loc{Corvega Assembly Plant}.
Tell the settler the job is done, which adds @loc{Tenpines Bluff} as an Allied Settlement.
Return to @npc{Preston Garvey} to turn in the quest, then agree to help him rebuild the Minutemen as the new General.

achievements.description: Finish the Minutemen quest Taking Independence.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the Minutemen quest Taking Independence.

guide.context: Complete any two Minutemen Radiant Quests; the next time you speak with @npc{Preston Garvey} he proposes retaking the Castle.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Preston Garvey} at the @loc{Castle} and help the Minutemen clear out the Mirelurks, including the Mirelurk Queen.
Use the Castle's Workshop to restore power to the Radio Transmitter.
Speak with Preston Garvey to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Finish the Minutemen quest Old Guns.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the Minutemen quest Old Guns.

guide.context: Old Guns opens roughly three days after retaking the Castle; ask Preston Garvey at the Castle, or wherever you last sent him, to begin. The unlock can fail after the quest ends, so make a save before you start.

steps.text: At the @loc{Castle}, follow @npc{Ronnie Shaw} through the Castle Tunnels, scrapping the rubble that blocks the entrance with the Castle's Workshop.
Collect the Artillery Schematic and smoke grenades from the Bastion at the far end of the tunnels.
Build an Artillery Piece with the Castle's Workshop and assign a settler or Minuteman to operate it.
Head to the test area, put on @loc{Radio Freedom}, and throw a smoke grenade to request the test barrage, then step clear of the target.
Return to @npc{Preston Garvey} to turn in the quest.

achievements.description: Join the Brotherhood of Steel by completing the faction quest Semper Invicta.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Join the Brotherhood of Steel by completing the faction quest Semper Invicta.

guide.context: To continue the Brotherhood faction questline afterward, complete a Radiant Quest for @npc{Scribe Haylen} and @npc{Knight Rhys}.

steps.text: Meet the Brotherhood of Steel at @loc{Cambridge Police Station} and speak with @npc{Paladin Danse}.
Complete @mechanic{Call to Arms} by accompanying @npc{Paladin Danse} to @loc{ArcJet Systems} and finding the @item{Deep Range Transmitter}.
After leaving @loc{ArcJet Systems}, accept @npc{Paladin Danse}'s offer to join the Brotherhood.
Return to @loc{Cambridge Police Station} and speak with @npc{Paladin Danse} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the Brotherhood of Steel Quest Blind Betrayal.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 8; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Brotherhood of Steel Quest Blind Betrayal.

guide.context: Follows Liberty Reprimed and is part of the Brotherhood line. Sparing @npc{Danse} needs high Charisma, or he must be executed; do not become enemies with the Brotherhood.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Elder Maxson} to learn that Paladin Danse is a Synth, then speak with @npc{Scribe Haylen} to learn he is hiding at @loc{Listening Post Bravo}.
Acquire Danse's Holotags and show them to Elder Maxson as proof, whether Danse is spared or killed.
If you spare Danse, Maxson confronts you at the Listening Post; with high Charisma convince him to let Danse go, or Danse must be executed.
Go back to Elder Maxson aboard the @loc{Prydwen} to finish the quest and be promoted to Paladin.

achievements.description: Complete the Brotherhood of Steel Quest Ad Victoriam.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 8; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Brotherhood of Steel Quest Ad Victoriam.

guide.context: This closes out the Brotherhood line. If you still intend to run the Railroad from an earlier save, skip the Tactical Thinking quest. Attacking the Brotherhood, or using the relay to enter the Mass Fusion building while Mass Fusion is active, permanently voids the Brotherhood achievements.

steps.text: After completing @loc{Spoils of War} and @loc{Blind Betrayal}, speak with @npc{Proctor Ingram} at the @loc{Boston Airport} and power up @enemy{Liberty Prime} with the @item{Beryllium Agitator}.
Stay with Liberty Prime as he reaches the @loc{C.I.T. Ruins}; drop into the hole he opens to get into the @loc{Institute} and finish the quest.

achievements.description: Join the Railroad by completing the Railroad quest Tradecraft.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Join the Railroad by completing the Railroad quest Tradecraft.

guide.context: If @npc{Deacon} stops moving when he must use the Terminal for the Inaccessible Security Door, save and reload to unstick him.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Deacon} to receive the Tradecraft quest.
Meet @npc{Deacon} along the old highway south of the @loc{Drumlin Dinner}.
Speak with the Tourist @npc{Ricky Dalton} for intel on the old Railroad HQ, then enter through the @loc{Sewers}.
Retrieve the missing @item{Prototype} with @npc{Deacon}.
Return to the @loc{Railroad HQ}, turn in @item{Carrington's Prototype} to @npc{Desdemona}, and accept when asked to join the Railroad.

achievements.description: Complete the Railroad Quest Underground Undercover.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 9; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Railroad Quest Underground Undercover.

guide.context: Part of the Railroad line. In the maintenance tunnel, kill the Synth Guards quickly once they detect you, or the Institute may become hostile.

steps.text: After entering the @loc{Institute}, return to @loc{Railroad HQ} and speak with @npc{Desdemona} to start making contact with @npc{Patriot}.
Follow the waypoint to the storeroom to meet Patriot and plan the synth rescue.
In the maintenance tunnel, dispatch the Synth Guards quickly after they detect you so the Institute does not become hostile.
Continue the Institute questline to the second Directorate meeting; a runner arrives with a message from @npc{Z1-14}.
Meet Z1-14, then head back to Railroad HQ and tell @npc{Desdemona} about the incoming Brotherhood attack to finish the quest.

achievements.description: Complete the Railroad Quest Rockets' Red Glare.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 9; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Railroad Quest Rockets' Red Glare.

guide.context: The Railroad ending, available right after Underground Undercover. The faction lines are mutually exclusive, so reload a save from before committing to play the Institute or Brotherhood endings.

steps.text: Sneak onto the @loc{Prydwen} and rig the three Gas Bag controllers with explosives.
Escape back to the @loc{Vertibird} and watch the Prydwen explode.
Report the success of project Red Glare back to @npc{Desdemona} to unlock the achievement, then stop speaking with her.

achievements.description: Complete the side quest Sanctuary.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the side quest Sanctuary.

guide.context: Beds count only when placed inside a building, and crops need the matching food item and an assigned settler. A single turret provides enough defense rating.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Sturges} in @loc{Sanctuary} to start the side quest.
Build enough beds for the settlers.
Provide water for the settlement.
Plant crops with a matching food item and assign a settler to them.
Build defenses for the settlement.
Speak with @npc{Sturges} after each objective to receive the next task.

achievements.description: Ally with 3 settlements.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Ally with 3 settlements.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Preston Garvey} to learn which settlements have requested aid.
Help @npc{Jake Finch} at @loc{Saugus Ironworks} to unlock @loc{Finch Farm}.
Complete other settlement requests from Minutemen Radiant Quests or from exploring.
Continue until you have allied with 3 settlements.

achievements.description: Raise a large Settlement to 100 Happiness.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Raise a large Settlement to 100 Happiness.

guide.context: Do not use robots, which cap Settlement Happiness at 50%, and do not rely on a companion, who does not count as a settler. Happiness rises slowly; if the unlock does not fire at 100, keep playing or fast travel across the map and back and it can trigger later.

steps.text: Clear all settlers from @loc{Red Rocket Truck Stop} and skip building a Recruitment Radio Beacon.
Store at least 20 Mutfruit and 20 Purified Water in the Settlement's Workshop.
Build at least 1 Bed and at least one Machinegun Turret for +5 Defense.
Build a Rank 2 Bar under Stores > Food & Drink; it requires the Local Leader perk at Rank 2.
Bring one settler over from another Settlement and put them to work at the Rank 2 Bar.
Wait until Settlement Happiness reaches 100.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Side Quests.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Side Quests.

guide.context: The 10 must be unique Side Quests; Miscellaneous Objectives and Radiant Quests do not count.

steps.text: Complete Side Quests throughout the Commonwealth until you have finished 10 unique ones.

achievements.description: Complete 50 Miscellaneous Objectives.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 Miscellaneous Objectives.

guide.context: Miscellaneous Objectives are separate from Side Quests, and the two large DLCs add more. Your Pip-Boy lists the count under Data > Stats > Quest.

steps.text: Complete Miscellaneous Objectives as you explore the Commonwealth and talk to people.

achievements.description: Gather 1000 crafting resources.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Gather 1000 crafting resources.

guide.context: Scrapped objects break down into multiple resources, so fewer than 1000 objects are needed. Resources count as gathered only after you take them from the Workshop.

steps.text: Scrap objects at @loc{Sanctuary}, @loc{Red Rocket Truck Stop}, and @loc{Tenpines Bluff}.
Open the @mechanic{Workshop} and choose @mechanic{Take All Junk} so the resources count as gathered.
Buy junk such as adhesive and metals from vendors for additional resources if needed.

achievements.description: Pick 50 locks.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Pick 50 locks.

guide.context: At least two points in @mechanic{Locksmith} greatly increases the number of locks available.

steps.text: Pick locks on safes, doors, and containers throughout the Commonwealth until the total reaches 50.
When a safe or door is secured by both a Lock and a Terminal, pick the Lock first, then use the Terminal, to earn XP from both.

achievements.description: Hack 50 Terminals.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Hack 50 Terminals.

guide.context: Put at least 3 points into the @mechanic{Hacker} perk to attempt harder Terminals; a fourth point removes any chance of failure. The Pip-Boy tracks your count under Data > Stats > Crime.

steps.text: Hack 50 Terminals across the Commonwealth.

achievements.description: Craft 50 weapon mods.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Craft 50 weapon mods.

guide.context: Only the crafting action counts, so stripping and rebuilding mods on the same few guns still advances the total. Gun Nut, Blacksmith, and Science perks unlock stronger weapon mods.

steps.text: Craft a Muzzle Mod on any gun at a @loc{Weapon Workbench}.
Repeatedly reselect the Muzzle Mod and No Muzzle to craft it again until 50 weapon mods are made.

achievements.description: Craft 100 items.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Craft 100 items.

guide.context: Weapon mods and workshop items do not count; only items made at a Cooking Station or Chemistry Station do. Make a save before grinding so you can reload afterward without spending the materials.

steps.text: Craft the fastest item, @item{Jet}, at a Chemistry Station; each one costs Fertilizer x2 and Plastic x1.
Craft 100 items total, using Jet or any cooked meat, Purified Water, or combined drug.

achievements.description: Recruit 5 Companions.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Recruit 5 Companions.

guide.context: @npc{Ada} from the Automatron DLC does not count toward this achievement.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Dogmeat} at @loc{Red Rocket Truck Stop}.
Recruit @npc{Codsworth} in @loc{Sanctuary} after @mechanic{Out of Time}.
Recruit @npc{Preston Garvey} after @mechanic{The First Step}.
Recruit @npc{Piper Wright} in @loc{Diamond City} after @mechanic{Story of the Century}.
Recruit @npc{Strong} after completing @mechanic{Curtain Call}.

achievements.description: Reach maximum Affinity with a companion.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach maximum Affinity with a companion.

guide.context: Romance is not required. @npc{Piper} gains Affinity quickly because she likes good or neutral choices and picking locks.

steps.text: Gather several companions at one Settlement with @npc{Dogmeat} as your current companion.
Shoot Dogmeat until he is down, then heal him with a Stimpak to raise the Affinity of the companions present.
Wait 48 hours, then repeat until a companion reaches maximum Affinity.

achievements.description: Build 100 Workshop items.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Build 100 Workshop items.

steps.text: Build 100 cheap Workshop items around @loc{Sanctuary}, such as fences, chairs, and lights, using Wood and Steel.

achievements.description: Play any Holotape Game.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Play any Holotape Game.

guide.context: Any Holotape Game found in the world counts, including those from RobCo Fun issues.

steps.text: In @loc{Vault 111}, move through the corridors past the first Radroach and enter the cafeteria straight ahead.
Use the @item{Recreation Terminal} on the desk behind the central seating.
Choose @mechanic{Play Tape} to start the inserted @item{Red Menace} game.

achievements.description: Kill 5 Super Mutant Behemoths or Mirelurk Queens while landing the killing blow yourself.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 Super Mutant Behemoths or Mirelurk Queens while landing the killing blow yourself.

guide.context: Kills credited to a companion do not advance the count. The unlock can fail even after the fifth kill, so kill an extra Mirelurk Queen during Taking Independence as a safeguard.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Swan} the Super Mutant Behemoth at @loc{Swan's Pond}.
Kill the Mirelurk Queen lurking in the flooded @loc{Massachusetts State House} basement.
Kill the Super Mutant Behemoth at @loc{Fort Strong}.
Restore the Workshop at @loc{Spectacle Island}, then kill the Mirelurk Queen that emerges.
Kill the Mirelurk Queen that guards the @loc{Vault 88} East Sector Workshop.

achievements.description: Discover 100 locations.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Discover 100 locations.

guide.context: The count rises naturally while chasing bobbleheads, magazines, Caps, junk, and enemies.

steps.text: Explore the Commonwealth and enter new locations until you have discovered 100.

achievements.description: Read 20 Magazines.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Read 20 Magazines.

guide.context: Well over 100 magazines exist in the Commonwealth, and most appear in quest-related locations, so loot thoroughly.

steps.text: Collect and read magazines throughout the Commonwealth until you have read 20.

achievements.description: Plant a grenade or mine in a character's inventory while pickpocketing.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Plant a grenade or mine in a character's inventory while pickpocketing.

guide.context: Requires Rank 2 of the Pickpocket perk so the placed explosive actually detonates.

steps.text: Spend two ranks in the @mechanic{Pickpocket} perk.
Make a save, then sneak behind any settler at a Settlement.
Open their inventory while pickpocketing and place a Frag Grenade, or any grenade or mine, inside it.

achievements.description: Kill 300 people.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Kill 300 people.

guide.context: This comes naturally as you play, but it may unlock after Animal Control if you spent time on optional exploration.

steps.text: Defeat people throughout the Commonwealth until the total reaches 300.

achievements.description: Kill 300 creatures.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Kill 300 creatures.

guide.context: Comes naturally during normal play; a completion run kills several times this number.

steps.text: Defeat creatures throughout the Commonwealth until the total reaches 300.

achievements.description: Touch all four baseball bases around Diamond City's old-world stadium and return to Home Plate in one quick loop.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Touch all four baseball bases around Diamond City's old-world stadium and return to Home Plate in one quick loop.

guide.context: The bases must be touched in a single quick loop, or the homerun will not register.

steps.text: Start at @loc{Home Plate}, just outside the @loc{Publick Occurrences} office on the wooden walkway.
Take first base by following the walkway to your right, past @loc{Polly's House} and the @loc{Dugout Inn}.
Touch second base further along to the left, past @loc{Doc Crocker's House} where the walkway floods.
Touch third base west past the @loc{Valentine Detective Agency} at the next junction.
Step back onto @loc{Home Plate} to register the homerun.

achievements.description: Be killed by a Mini-Nuke explosion.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Be killed by a Mini-Nuke explosion.

guide.context: Both a Fat Man shot and a Suicidal Super Mutant's self-destruct explosion qualify.

steps.text: Near @loc{Red Rocket Truck Stop}, just outside @loc{Lexington}, a Power Armor Raider carrying a Fat Man waits on the walkway behind the @loc{Slocum Joe's} billboard.
Save your game first, then let him kill you with a Mini-Nuke.

achievements.description: Collect 10 Vault-Tec Bobbleheads.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Vault-Tec Bobbleheads.

guide.context: There are 20 Vault-Tec Bobbleheads in total.

steps.text: Collect Vault-Tec Bobbleheads throughout the Commonwealth until you have collected 10.

achievements.description: Collect 20 Vault-Tec Bobbleheads.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 Vault-Tec Bobbleheads.

guide.context: Twenty Vault-Tec Bobbleheads are scattered across the Commonwealth; the Big Guns Bobblehead inside Vault 95 is the last one in the set.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Vault 95}, south of the Edge of the Glowing Sea, and ride the elevator down.
Fight through the Gunner blockade in the central lobby and enter the Residential wing.
Descend the stairs, pass through the wrecked wall, and turn right past a Machine Gun Turret.
Take the @item{Big Guns Bobblehead} from the center of the Gunner Lieutenant's suite, on top of the playing radio.

achievements.description: Reach Level 5.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 5.

steps.text: Earn XP from quests, combat, and building until you reach Level 5.

achievements.description: Reach Level 10.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 1; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 10.

steps.text: Earn XP from quests, combat, and exploration until you reach Level 10.

achievements.description: Reach Level 25.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 4; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 25.

steps.text: Earn XP from quests, combat, and exploration until you reach Level 25.

achievements.description: Reach Level 50.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 50.

guide.context: There is no Level cap, so progress continues past Level 50.

steps.text: Reach Level 50 by playing through the game, the DLCs, and Settlement building.

achievements.description: Finish the main quest through any of the four faction endings.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 6; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the main quest through any of the four faction endings.

guide.context: The Institute has a unique ending, Nuclear Family; the Minutemen, Railroad, and Brotherhood endings all award The Nuclear Option.

steps.text: Complete the final quest of the Institute, Minutemen, Railroad, or Brotherhood of Steel line.

achievements.description: Complete the Automatron quest Mechanical Menace.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Automatron quest Mechanical Menace.

guide.context: Requires the Automatron DLC and a character at Level 15. @npc{Ada} becomes a unique Companion but does not count toward Never Go It Alone.

steps.text: Listen to the @mechanic{Caravan Distress Frequency} on the radio to receive the quest and a waypoint near @loc{Cambridge}.
At the scene, defeat the hostile robots attacking the friendly ones; save first and lure the enemies apart.
Speak with the friendly robot @npc{Ada} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Finish the Automatron quest Headhunting.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the Automatron quest Headhunting.

guide.context: Jezebel's outcome does not matter; any choice lets you collect the Radar Beacon and complete the quest.

steps.text: Install the Mechanist Device on @npc{Ada} with a Robot Workbench; collect it first from the Robobrain at the @loc{General Atomics Factory}.
Destroy the Robobrain north of @loc{Fort Hagen} and take its Radar Beacon.
Travel to the @loc{Fort Hagen Satellite Array} west of Fort Hagen and take the Radar Beacon from Jezebel.

achievements.description: Finish the Automatron quest Restoring Order.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish the Automatron quest Restoring Order.

steps.text: Install the M-SAT device on a robot, ideally @npc{Ada}.
Head for the @loc{RobCo Sales & Service Center} and battle your way through the Mechanist's robot waves.
Talk the Mechanist down or kill them, then shut down the Master Control Terminal.
Speak with Ada for a final conversation to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Unlock 10 Robot Mods by looting them from defeated robots.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 5; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Unlock 10 Robot Mods by looting them from defeated robots.

guide.context: Servomechs sometimes attack your Settlements during Defend Settlement objectives, giving extra chances to loot mods.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Servomechs} and Rust Devil patrols, then loot the Robot Mods they drop.
Complete Automatron DLC missions for additional Robot Mods.
Repeat until 10 Robot Mods are unlocked.

achievements.description: Build 10 Robot Mods.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 2; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Build 10 Robot Mods.

guide.context: Requires the Robot Workbench, unlocked by completing @mechanic{Mechanical Menace}. The main materials are Adhesive, Aluminum, Ceramic, Circuitry, Rubber, and Steel.

steps.text: Build a @item{Robot Workbench} at @loc{Sanctuary} or your primary settlement.
Mod a robot companion such as @npc{Ada} or @npc{Codsworth}, or a custom robot.
Swap parts such as cheap limbs and heads until you have built 10 Robot Mods.

achievements.description: Keep 5 tamed creatures in a single settlement.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 7; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Keep 5 tamed creatures in a single settlement.

guide.context: Domestic animals such as cats, dogs, and gorillas do not count, and Raiders, Gunners, Mutant Hounds, and Super Mutants cannot be tamed. Tame 5 of the same creature kind, because different kinds fight each other.

steps.text: Get Rank 1 of the @mechanic{Animal Friend} perk and the @mechanic{Wasteland Whisperer} perk to build a @item{Beta Wave Emitter}.
Build Cages and wire them to Power, then rest in a nearby Bed to skip time; creatures begin appearing in the cages after roughly 1-3 days.
Build the Beta Wave Emitter and turn it on to tame the captured creatures.
To unlock the achievement, have five tamed creatures living together in one Settlement.

achievements.description: Start an Arena Fight in a Settlement with Settlers watching.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 7; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Start an Arena Fight in a Settlement with Settlers watching.

steps.text: At a Settlement with at least two Settlers, build the @item{Arena Contestant Blue Team} and @item{Red Team} stages from the Cages - Arena tab.
Build a @item{Quitting Time Siren} near the arena pads and connect it to Power.
Make a save, then activate the Quitting Time Siren so Settlers gather to watch.
Assign one Settler to the Blue stage and one to the Red stage to start the fight and unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Build all 15 Cage types.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 7; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Build all 15 Cage types.

guide.context: Cages can be built at any Settlements, need no Power, and do not need to catch a creature.

steps.text: Open a Settlement's Workshop and build every cage in the Cages tab: 4 Small, 5 Medium, and 6 Large.
Place the fifteenth cage to unlock the achievement; the gorilla cage is not needed.
Build these in a disposable outpost ringed with heavy turrets, since caged spawns can turn hostile.

achievements.description: Arrive at Far Harbor by boat from the Nakano Residence.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Arrive at Far Harbor by boat from the Nakano Residence.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @loc{Getting A Clue}, then speak with @npc{Ellie} at the @loc{Detective Agency} in @loc{Diamond City} to start @loc{Far From Home}.
Head to the @loc{Nakano Residence} at the far north-east edge of the Commonwealth and speak with @npc{Kenji Nakano} about his missing daughter.
Search the boathouse next to the residence, open the Expert-locked safe, and take the holotape.
Listen to the holotape and return to the Nakanos to tell them what you found.
Do not report to the @loc{Brotherhood of Steel} or the @loc{Institute}, then board the boat at the residence.
Stay on the boat until it reaches @loc{Far Harbor}; the achievement unlocks when the boat arrives.

achievements.description: Uncover DiMA's plan in Acadia and report back to Kasumi.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Uncover DiMA's plan in Acadia and report back to Kasumi.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Kasumi Nakano} in @loc{Acadia} to start the search for @npc{DiMA}'s secrets.
Talk to @npc{DiMA} directly to learn what is at stake.
Return to @npc{Kasumi} in @loc{Acadia} and report what DiMA is planning to complete @loc{Where You Belong}.

achievements.description: Finish The Way Life Should Be by siding with either Acadia or the Children of Atom.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{The Way Life Should Be} by choosing the side of Acadia or the Children of Atom.

guide.context: This is one half of a mutually exclusive pair with @loc{Cleansing the Land}. Make a hard save before starting @loc{Best Left Forgotten} so you can reload that save to pursue the other outcome. Never destroy Acadia or kill @npc{Kasumi}, which voids @loc{Close to Home}.

steps.text: Make a hard save before starting @loc{Best Left Forgotten}.
Finish @loc{Best Left Forgotten}, then decide which faction to back and agree to their plan during @loc{The Way Life Should Be}.
Take the peaceful route that favors @loc{Acadia} or the @loc{Children of Atom}; the quest completes and the achievement unlocks once you agree to that plan.

achievements.description: Destroy Far Harbor or the Nucleus.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Destroy @loc{Far Harbor} or the @loc{Nucleus}.

guide.context: This is the opposite outcome to @loc{The Way Life Should Be}; reload a hard save made before @loc{Best Left Forgotten} to pursue it. Keep @loc{Cleansing the Land} active while finishing @npc{DiMA}'s @loc{Reformation} quest, or the achievement cannot be completed.

steps.text: Keep @loc{Cleansing the Land} active through @loc{Best Left Forgotten}.
To destroy @loc{Far Harbor}, enter the wind farm and use the kill switch code.
To destroy the @loc{Children of Atom}, use the nuclear launch key at the @loc{Nucleus}.
Trigger either destruction to unlock the achievement; completing @loc{Reformation} for @npc{DiMA} also works while the quest is active.

achievements.description: Return to Kasumi in Acadia after the ending and complete Close to Home.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Return to @npc{Kasumi} in @loc{Acadia} after the ending and complete @loc{Close to Home}.

guide.context: The achievement unlocks whether Kasumi is told to stay in Acadia or to return to her parents. Destroying Acadia or killing Kasumi voids the quest and this achievement.

steps.text: After the Far Harbor questline ends, return to @npc{Kasumi} in @loc{Acadia}.
Talk to Kasumi and guide her toward her next step.
Finish @loc{Close to Home}; either answer unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Gather all five issues of The Islander's Almanac.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Gather all five issues of @item{The Islander's Almanac}.

collectibles.name: The Islander's Almanac Issue 1
collectibles.method: Take the issue from the table beside @npc{Old Longfellow}.

collectibles.name: The Islander's Almanac Issue 2
collectibles.method: Descend the stairwell to the first sublevel, enter the common area, and take the issue from the long counter @npc{Dejen} runs, next to the candles.

collectibles.name: The Islander's Almanac Issue 3
collectibles.method: Enter the gift shop in the main building and take the issue from the front counter.

collectibles.name: The Islander's Almanac Issue 4
collectibles.location: @loc{Brooke's Head Lighthouse} — top floor, Trapper leader's quarters
collectibles.method: Climb to the top of the lighthouse and take the issue from the table beside the Cookstove in the Trapper leader's quarters.

collectibles.name: The Islander's Almanac Issue 5
collectibles.method: Head inside the quarry, climb through the Trapper hideout to its top floor, and collect the issue from the table beside the main Steamer Trunk.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 Far Harbor sea creatures.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat 30 Far Harbor sea creatures.

guide.context: Only Far Harbor creatures count: Anglers, Gulpers, Hermit Crabs, and Fog Crawlers. Base-game creatures such as Mirelurks do not count.

steps.text: Hunt @enemy{Anglers}, @enemy{Gulpers}, and @enemy{Fog Crawlers} in the ocean between @loc{Fringe Cove Docks} and the @loc{Children of Atom Shrine}.
Walk between the two spots instead of fast traveling, then pass 24 hours so the creatures respawn.
Check the area around @loc{Lureweed}, where @enemy{Anglers} often appear.
Defeat 30 Far Harbor sea creatures to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Discover 20 Far Harbor locations.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Discover 20 Far Harbor locations.

guide.context: Locations found while completing other Far Harbor objectives also count toward the total.

steps.text: Discover locations as you travel around @loc{Far Harbor}.
Reach 20 discovered locations to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 Far Harbor workshop locations.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Unlock 3 Far Harbor workshop locations.

guide.context: Far Harbor holds only 4 workshops in total, so any 3 unlocked locations count toward the achievement.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Old Longfellow} at @loc{Acadia} to unlock the @loc{Longfellow's Camp} workshop automatically.
Start @loc{Blood Tide} from @npc{Cassie Dalton} and complete its second stage by killing the Fog Crawler at @loc{Dalton Farm}, then return to Cassie to unlock the Dalton Farm workshop.
Complete @loc{Living On the Edge} and speak with @npc{Teddy Wright} to start @loc{Rite of Passage}.
Toss a piece of Meat into the water to draw out the Mirelurk Queen, kill it, then report to @npc{Teddy Wright} to unlock another workshop.

During @loc{The Changing Tide}, help @npc{Mitch} for the @loc{National Park Visitor's Center} (speak with @npc{Uncle Ken} there) or help @npc{Small Bertha} for @loc{Echo Lake Lumber} through @loc{Turn Back the Fog}.
Reach 3 unlocked Far Harbor workshops; the achievement unlocks once the third settlement is secured.

achievements.description: Cook one Far Harbor recipe.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 11; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Cook one Far Harbor recipe.

guide.context: Any Far Harbor recipe counts. @item{Poached Angler} needs a single Angler Meat, while @item{Fried Fog Crawler} needs Oil x1 and Raw Fog Crawler Meat x1.

steps.text: Gather the ingredients for a Far Harbor recipe; @item{Poached Angler} needs a single @item{Angler Meat}.
Cook the recipe at any cooking station to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Display one weapon on a Weapon Rack, one piece of armor on an Armor Rack, and a suit of Power Armor on a Power Armor Display.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Display one weapon on a Weapon Rack, one piece of armor on an Armor Rack, and a suit of Power Armor on a Power Armor Display.

steps.text: Build a Weapon Rack from Decorations > Display, then transfer a matching weapon into its inventory.
Build an Armor Rack, then transfer a single outfit or piece of armor into its inventory and equip it.
Build a Power Armor Display from Decorations > Display and attach a Generator for its Power x1 requirement.
Enter a Power Armor suit, walk as close as possible to the display, exit the armor, then select the display and activate it to set the suit out.

achievements.description: Assign one of your settlers to a Pillory.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Assign one of your settlers to a Pillory.

guide.context: Assigning a companion to investigate the Pillory locks them in but does not count. The assigned settler stays locked in until you give them a different task.

steps.text: Build a Pillory from the Workshop menu under Resources > Miscellaneous; it costs Wood x4 and Concrete x1.
Assign a settler to the Pillory.

achievements.description: Have your Builders produce 100 objects.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Have your Builders produce 100 objects.

guide.context: Sleeping or Waiting does not advance production; stay in the Settlement or keep moving around it. One Builder takes roughly 30 minutes to reach 100 objects, and more Builders finish faster.

steps.text: Build a Builder under Power > Manufacturing > Machinery; it costs Circuitry x2, Gears x3, Rubber x4, and Steel x10 and needs Power x8.
Build a Terminal and wire it to the Builder, then change the produced item from the default Steel Balls to Vault Tec Lunchboxes.
Place Steel x300, or objects totaling Steel x300, into the Builder's inventory.
Attach a Conveyor Storage to the Builder so the produced objects do not pile up and cause a bug.
Stay near the Settlement until the Builder has produced 100 objects.

achievements.description: Become Overseer of Vault 88.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Become Overseer of Vault 88.

guide.context: When Overseer Barstow offers to leave, do not pick the persuasion option that asks her to stay on as Overseer; she remains in charge and the title never passes to you.

steps.text: Finish the final prototype in the @loc{Vault 88} quest Lady Luck.
Speak with @npc{Overseer Barstow} and agree when she says she is leaving, making you the new Overseer of Vault 88.

achievements.description: Unlock all 3 build areas in Vault 88.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 3 build areas in Vault 88.

guide.context: Each of the 3 Workshops needs its own Control Board, and selecting a Workshop sets a waypoint to that Control Board.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Vault 88} quest Explore Vault 88 by activating all 3 Workshops.
Scrap the Limestone and Rockslides blocking any sealed Workshop in Build Mode.
Kill the Mirelurk Queen that protects the East Sector Workshop, past the train-tunnel Rockslide in the main Vault chamber.

achievements.description: Give a settler a Vault 88 Jumpsuit and a Pip-Boy.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 3; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Give a settler a Vault 88 Jumpsuit and a Pip-Boy.

guide.context: The Vault 88 Jumpsuit and Pip-Boy restock inside the Vault Trunk at the Vault 88 entrance, so the equipment can be replaced if it is lost.

steps.text: During the @loc{Vault 88} quest Power to the People, pick a settler candidate together with Overseer Barstow.
Open the nearby Vault Trunk and equip the settler with a @item{Vault 88 Jumpsuit} and a @item{Pip-Boy}.

achievements.description: Finish 12 side quests for the Nuka-World raider gangs.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Finish 12 side quests for the Nuka-World raider gangs.

guide.context: Attacking named or unnamed gang members after leaving the Gauntlet can permanently lock you out of these quests.

steps.text: Take a radiant side quest from any gang leader in Nuka-World: the Operators, the Disciples, or the Pack.
Complete the quest in the Commonwealth, then take another; repeat until 12 raider side quests are done.
Take one job from all three leaders before leaving, so 12 quests need only about four trips.

achievements.description: Collect all 5 Scav! magazine issues.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Collect all 5 Scav! magazine issues.

collectibles.name: Scav! Issue #1
collectibles.method: Circle the right side of Starport Nuka through the open gate, pass the security post guarded by Protectrons, and pick up the issue from the wooden crates beside the wrecked bus.

collectibles.name: Scav! Issue #2
collectibles.method: Go north-east of the junkyard map icon to the metal warehouse on the outskirts, climb to the second floor, and take the issue from the desk beside the Star Core.

collectibles.name: Scav! Issue #3
collectibles.method: Make your way through the Fun House, passing the Hall of Mirrors, the Bottle Jumps, and the sped-up conveyor belt, then enter the Hypno Halls. Take the green tunnel on the right, then the next green tunnel ahead, and collect the issue at the dead end beside the dead Raider.

collectibles.name: Scav! Issue #4
collectibles.method: Follow the mansion tour to the room where the rogue Raider Zachariah appears, pick the Master Lock on the red door with 3 ranks of the Locksmith perk, then go upstairs and take the issue from the crate immediately to the right.

collectibles.name: Scav! Issue #5
collectibles.method: Reach the employee area in the open after restoring power to Nuka-World, or use parkour from the Gulch Theater stands or a Power Armor jet pack to get there early; the issue is on the table next to the Frag Mines.

achievements.description: Craft all 20 different Nuka-Cola flavors at a Nuka-Mixer Station.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Craft all 20 different Nuka-Cola flavors at a Nuka-Mixer Station.

guide.context: The 15 Nuka-World recipes are Nuka-Cide, Nuka-Love, Nuka-Frutti, Nuka-Punch, Nuka-Power, Nuka-Lixir, Nuka-Berry, Nuka-Hearty, Nuka-Rush, Nuka-Sunrise, Nuka-Xtreme, Nuka-Bombdrop, Nuka-Cooler, Nuka-Void, and Nuka-Ray; the remaining five come with a Nuka-Mixer Station. Some recipe books may fail to appear or fall through the ground, so keep a separate hard save before starting the DLC.

steps.text: Build a Nuka-Mixer Station at a settlement to unlock the five starter recipes.
Find the 15 Nuka-Cola recipes hidden throughout Nuka-World and read each one.
Craft every flavor at a Nuka-Mixer Station, including each of the 20 at least once and each one different.
Buy missing base Nuka-Cola types from Shelbie Chase at the Nuka-Town Market; sit on a chair or bench and wait 24 hours to restock her inventory.

achievements.description: Establish 8 raider outposts across the Commonwealth.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Establish 8 raider outposts across the Commonwealth.

guide.context: Establishing this many outposts ruins settlements and supply lines, and makes Preston permanently hostile; make a save beforehand if you want to restore them later. Convincing settlers to supply a nearby outpost does not count toward the total, and becoming an enemy of the raiders can make the achievement unobtainable.

steps.text: Ask Shank for jobs and claim raider outposts in the Commonwealth until eight are established.
If you were attacked by the rogue gang when you returned to Nuka-World, speak with Shank afterward to continue claiming.
Pick small settlements such as Tenpines Bluff, Oberland, or Sunshine Tidings to finish faster.

achievements.description: Defeat 40 creatures in Nuka-World while any Nuka-Mix flavor is in effect.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Defeat 40 creatures in Nuka-World while any Nuka-Mix flavor is in effect.

guide.context: Only flavors crafted at a Nuka-Mixer Station count; Nuka-Mix bottles found as loot do not. Counting creatures include ants, bloodworms, brahmiluffs, cave crickets, and gatorclaws, plus rad-rats, while base-game enemies such as Raiders, Mirelurks, and Molerats do not count.

steps.text: Craft a Nuka-Mix flavor at a Nuka-Mixer Station.
Drink the mix and confirm its effect is still active under Stat > Status on the Pip-Boy before or during combat.
Defeat Nuka-World creatures while the effect is active, and repeat until 40 kills are counted.

achievements.description: Redeem 100,000 Nuka-Cade tickets.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Redeem 100,000 Nuka-Cade tickets.

guide.context: Pre-War Cash exchanges for Nuka-Cade Tokens, which buy plays; tokens also appear throughout the DLC. You do not need to spend the tickets on a prize, and the terminal tracks how many have been redeemed.

steps.text: Build Nuka-Cade games at a settlement under Decorations > Nuka-World > Nuka-Cade.
Build Hoop Shot machines and use the Mat Method: place Rubber Mats so the machines stack, letting one dunk score for several machines.
Insert tokens into every machine, grab a Basketball, stand above the basket, and repeatedly press Crouch to dunk until you have 100,000 tickets.
Make a save, then go to the Nuka-Cade opposite The Parlour in Nuka-Town and redeem all tickets at the Nuka-Cade Prize Terminal.

achievements.description: Complete Taken for a Ride and become the Overboss of Nuka-World.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete Taken for a Ride and become the Overboss of Nuka-World.

steps.text: Reach level 30, then listen to the Nuka-World radio broadcast on the Pip-Boy to mark the Nuka-World Transit Center on the map.
Head west to the Nuka-World Transit Center, defeat the Gunners outside, and enter to find the injured trader Harvey.
Restore power to the Nuka-Express and ride the monorail to Nuka-World.
Fight through the Gauntlet to the Cola-Cars Arena and, with Porter Gage's help, use the Thirst Zapper to strip Overboss Colter's defenses and kill him.
Speak with Porter Gage to be placed in charge of Nuka-World; the achievement unlocks when the conversation ends.

achievements.description: Claim all five Nuka-World territories for the raider gangs, then speak with Porter Gage.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Claim all five Nuka-World territories for the raider gangs, then speak with Porter Gage.

guide.context: Planting a gang flag makes Preston permanently hostile and cannot be undone, though it does not make you an enemy of the Minutemen. The gang given the fewest territories turns on you at the end of the DLC.

steps.text: Travel to each of the five territories: Kiddie Kingdom, the Nuka-Cola Bottling Plant, Safari Adventure, Dry Rock Gulch, and the Galactic Zone.
Plant a gang flag on the Signal Flagpole in each of the five territories.
Speak with Porter Gage in Nuka-World to complete The Grand Tour and unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the Home Sweet Home quest by establishing raider outposts in the Commonwealth.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Home Sweet Home quest by establishing raider outposts in the Commonwealth.

guide.context: Raider outposts turn Preston permanently hostile, and that cannot be undone. Converting a settlement into a Supplier does not count as creating a raider outpost.

steps.text: Speak with Shank and choose a settlement from his list to receive the radiant quest to take it.
Follow every task Shank gives you to set up the outpost; when the option appears, send Shank to a Commonwealth outpost to avoid repeated loading trips to Nuka-World.
Ask Shank for more jobs and claim two more raider outposts to finish Home Sweet Home.

achievements.description: Complete the Power Play quest.
achievements.sortReason: Roadmap stage 10; complete when its requirements are available.
achievements.summary: Complete the Power Play quest.

guide.context: Whichever gang received the fewest territories during The Grand Tour turns against you. If Shank is in Nuka-World, you are attacked as soon as you return.

steps.text: Return to Nuka-World and go to the area beyond the Power Plant to meet the gang leaders.
Hunt down and kill the leader of the gang that turned against you.
Switch the power on.
Speak with Porter Gage to complete Power Play and the DLC.
